text:
Elena: kicked off the primer/cascade microbench overnight, need a compact econ + risk note for GTN.
Marcus: artifacts uploaded: https://s3.redwood/primer/4209991234 (slices + sims). quick numbers below.
Noah: TL;DR please (per-100k tokens, p95, and quality hotspots).
Marcus: baseline (prod 13b-int8): per-100k = $9.70, p95 = 330ms, longform F1 = 0.894
Marcus: primer-cascade (6b-int4 drafts + 13b-int8 finalize + tokenized priming + cache-shards) per-100k = $4.95, p95 = 360ms, longform F1 = 0.886
Marcus: priming overhead = +6% tokens, search recall +2.4% on short queries
Elena: nominal ~49% savings. with finalize rerank on ~2.5% traffic net ~45% savings.
Noah: where is the quality degradation concentrated? hallucination, factual recall, or structure?
Marcus: mostly narrative structure/coherence on outputs >900 tokens; list/enumeration fidelity drops a bit. QA/extraction parity.
Priya: product wants <0.01 abs drop on longform. routing + cascade rerank recoverable?
Marcus: yes. propose length+confidence cascade with a cheap semantic-diff check and finalize only for low-confidence or long outputs. also enable cache-shard warmstart for active users to reduce p95.
Elena: suggested routing policy:
- short (<150 tokens): nova6b-int4 primary (90%); finalize rarely
- mid (150-700): nova6b-int4 primary (70%), finalize on low-confidence -> 13b-int8
- long (>700): 13b-int8 primary; use 6b drafts only for latency-sensitive clients and re-run finalize on low-confidence
Elena: include rerank flow id `cascade-diff-rerank` to catch structure regressions cheaply.
Marcus: sims with that policy => cost reduction ~42-48% depending on finalize rate; longform F1 within ~0.006 of baseline when `cascade-diff-rerank` applied to flagged outputs.
Noah: what gating and monitoring do we need for GTN?
Elena: feature flag `primer.cascade.v1`. Canary 3% -> 15% -> 50% with automated sample 0.2% to full-eval for first 14 days. rollback if: longform_F1_drop > 0.01 abs OR regen_rate > 1.5x OR p95 > 520ms.
Marcus: add A/B arms for tokenized priming intensity (6% vs 10%) and for finalize sampling threshold.
ops-bot: scheduled: canary primer.cascade.v1 -> 3% at 4209991250, healthchecks enabled.
Noah: ops copy config snippet (pasteable):
```json
{"flag":"primer.cascade.v1","priming":{"tokens_pct":6},"routing":[{"max_len":150,"primary":"nova6b-int4","primary_weight":0.9},{"min_len":151,"max_len":700,"primary":"nova6b-int4","fallback":"13b-int8","primary_weight":0.7},{"min_len":701,"primary":"13b-int8","fallback":"nova6b-int4","primary_weight":1.0}],"rerank_flow":"cascade-diff-rerank"}
```
Elena: GTN also wants per-endpoint amortized appendix: search:-52% cost, chat:-40%, summarization:-24% (summarization risk noted). Marcus will draft exact numbers.
Marcus: will attach table + sims in PR and include per-endpoint sensitivity slices.
Noah: add metrics to dashboards: struct_coherence, list_fidelity, semantic_diff_score, per-route F1, regen_rate, per-user p95.
Priya: good. schedule the priming intensity micro-arm after canary if stability looks ok.
Elena: GTN wants the one-pager by EOD. thanks team :rocket:
Marcus: on it. ping me for raw slices.
ops-bot: note: healthcheck alerting configured (p95, regen-rate, error-rate).
